text:
Lena: Heads up — Prospect 'AstraFunds' sent a 38-page security questionnaire. They want: SIEM ingest evidence (offline export ok), tenant KMS rotation history (last 2 rotations), and proof RBAC modifications are auditable and tamper-evident. Can we pull a tidy evidence bundle by EOD?

Raj: I can cut the exports. Quick check: do they accept NDJSON + signed manifest or do they insist on live SIEM HEC? Also confirm whether PII needs redaction examples.

Lena: Offline NDJSON + signed manifest is fine for first pass. They specifically asked for redaction methodology and sample before/after. Also want a chain-of-trust proof for RBAC changes (they called out immutability).

Hannah: We'll provide:
- redacted NDJSON audit export for tenant (date range they requested)
- manifest.json listing file checksums, signer id, and kms_envelope_key_id
- detached signature manifest.sig from platform signer
- RBAC chain anchors (daily anchor hashes + signature)
- KMS describe-key outputs for envelope key (timestamps redacted where necessary)

Hannah: Example verification snippet to include in docs:

```bash
# download artifacts
curl -O https://s3.internal/astra/audit_astra_2026-04-02.ndjson
curl -O https://s3.internal/astra/manifest.json
curl -O https://s3.internal/astra/manifest.sig
# verify manifest signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_root_pub.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
# check file checksum
sha256sum -c <<< "e3b0c442...  audit_astra_2026-04-02.ndjson"
```

Raj: Redaction pipeline is audit-redact v3. We replace user.email => hash:user_email_hash and redact sensitive fields like ssn completely. Will attach a 2-line before/after sample and the ruleset doc.

Hannah: RBAC immutability: events are append-only in audit_events. We compute a daily Merkle-ish anchor (SHA256 chain) and sign each anchor with the platform signing key. We'll export anchors covering the requested window. Verifier recomputes per-batch hash and validates the anchor signature.

Raj: For KMS rotation evidence we'll include describe-key outputs and rotation_history entries for the envelope key. Example snippet (sanitized):

```json
{"KeyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:XXXX:key/ENVELOPE-XYZ","RotationEnabled":true,"RotationHistory":["2025-10-12T14:01:00Z","2026-02-08T03:21:00Z"]}
```

Lena: Please stage everything under /private/astra-evidence/ and post the links here when done. I'll prepare an SQ crosswalk mapping each questionnaire item to the artifact.

audit-bot: Ticket SEC-2042 created: "AstraFunds SQ evidence bundle" assigned to @Hannah @Raj.

Hannah: Uploaded artifacts:
- /private/astra-evidence/audit_astra_2026-04-02.ndjson
- /private/astra-evidence/manifest.json
- /private/astra-evidence/manifest.sig
- /private/astra-evidence/rbac_anchors_2026-04-02.txt
- /private/astra-evidence/redaction_rules_v3.md
- /private/astra-evidence/redaction_sample_before_after.txt
- /private/astra-evidence/kms_describe_envelope_2026-04-02.json (sanitized)

Raj: Added a short verification README in the folder with exact commands and the public key.

Lena: Great. I'll assemble and send the initial packet to their security inbox. If they ask for live SIEM demo we'll schedule a controlled demo with scrubbed data. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
